AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Airport Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airport Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airport Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airport Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Airport Safety.

2. When learning Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircraft Tools and Materials 2.3 Aircraft Related Drawin.

   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

6. When learning Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.

7. When learning Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construct.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

10. When learning Introduction to Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
